description:
The toons of Gardenview split up into groups to participate in the annual Pool Noodle Jousting Competition at the local swimming pool. When Astro learns that Dandy is the leader of one of the two teams he begs Dandy to let him play, but Dandy is adamant that Astro should stay out of it as Sprout takes the event way too far, and that he often hurts other toons very, very badly.
